name: player_apply_gun_fire_slot_offset_to_node
description: Player::ApplyGunFireSlotOffsetToNode clears pending left, right, and center alt-fire slot offsets and applies the reset transforms to their slot nodes.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player alt-gun/runtime-state source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43a980 validates the fastcall save-state ABI, gunNode null guard, nonzero tests for PlayerGunFireSlot entries at playerState+0xf08/+0xf10/+0xf18, zeroing each pending offset before calling Player::DecayAndApplyAltFireSlotOffsetToNode, passing gunFireDir.y as the slot aim Y, and using applyMatrix=1 for left/right and 0 for center.
The shared native smoke verifies the early return when gunNode is absent and the three-slot clear/apply behavior when gunNode is present.
